# Kelly Smith

> Entrepreneur, product leader, and technologist based in Boise, Idaho. Developer of Teligant, the first AI-native telehealth system.

Kelly Smith is a technology polymath working at the intersection of design and code. He was formerly Head of Digital/Technology at Starbucks, Athletic Greens/AG1, MGM Resorts, and Hagerty. Earlier, companies he founded or invested in were acquired by Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Comcast, ESPN, and Priceline.

## Current Ventures
- [Curious Office](https://curiousoffice.com): Innovation lab, seed investment, startup incubation
- [Teligant](https://teligant.com): Telehealth & clinic management
- [Hedfirst](https://hedfirst.com): AI-powered primary care
- [Axacraft](https://axacraft.com): AI-first enterprise solutions & agentic development
- [Pitform](https://pitform.com): Operating system for automotive events

## Previously
- Chief Digital Officer, Athletic Greens
- Vice President, Product, Starbucks
- Chief Digital Officer, MGM Resorts
- Chief Digital Officer, Hagerty

## Interests
- Collecting classic air-cooled Porsches (and the occasional Ferrari from Maranello)
